description: This file defines a PHP trait `MacAuthorizationTrait` that provides methods to generate MAC (Message Authentication Code) authorization headers for OAuth2 providers. It includes abstract methods that must be implemented by any class using this trait, focusing on token identification and signature generation.

methods.name: getAuthorizationHeaders
methods.description: Generates the 'MAC' authorization header array for a given access token, including timestamp, nonce, and signature.
